definitions_fixed_before_computing.must_not_miss_harm: one guard case: +3 posture falls per evaluation seed (pooled +9/96, survival -3/32), or tracking proxy -0.02 per seed
definitions_fixed_before_computing.allowed_loss: half of the harm, rounded down: pooled falls +3, survival median -0.03125, tracking median -0.01

designs.margin: allowed-loss margin on the same 22 checks
designs.margin_split: margin, with separate harm/allowed loss for stairs_10_down and rough_lateral falls/survival (+5/seed harm, +2/seed allowed) and rough_forward tracking (-0.04 harm, -0.02 allowed); user choice 2026-09-26, fixed before computing
designs.margin_split_dedup: margin_split with the eight survival checks removed (they re-count the same robot falls); 14 checks; same values; user choice 2026-09-26
designs.resample: one-sided 1% per-check cut from a separate calibration resample

not_applied_to: G-A048 (its verdict INTERNAL_GATE_FAIL is preserved; no design here is evaluated on it)
reported_as: resampling sensitivity conditional on the stored G-A033 sample; harms are added to case values, not simulated; not a server re-run error rate
